title: How do I view survey results?
intent: This article explains how to view the submitted contributions and statistics for a survey.
short_answer: To view results, open the survey in the management area and navigate to the Results page. This page shows all submitted contributions in a table format with filtering and sorting options. You can view individual contributions, see charts and statistics, and access export options.
prerequisites: The user must have AccessResults privilege or be the survey owner
The survey must have at least one submitted contribution
procedure: Open the survey in the management area.
Use filters to narrow results (date range, language, specific answers).
Click on a contribution to view its details.
Access charts and statistics from the results toolbar.
Use export options to download data.
important_conditions: Maximum 3 filters can be active simultaneously.
Results can be filtered by date range, language, and answer values.
Test answers can be excluded from results using the filter.
Results can be sorted by various columns.
Individual contributions can be viewed, printed, or deleted.
Statistics show aggregated data per question.
troubleshooting: 'You used too many search filters': Reduce to maximum 3 active filters.
No results showing: Verify that contributions have been submitted and filters are not too restrictive.
'No Form Loaded' error: Navigate to the survey management area first.
